metadata.title: Product Bricks & Streams
metadata.description: Hierarchical product brick map for the freelancer-bookkeeping-service-platform domain, modeled on Kees de Boekhouder and its sister company Founders: the client administration app with dashboard, Scan & Herken, invoicing and the Ponto bank connection, the bookkeeping engine with VAT, annual accounts, income tax, corporate tax and payroll filings to the Belastingdienst and KVK, the bookkeeper workspace with review, QA, allocation, calendar, messaging and knowledge base, the growth and client lifecycle of intro calls, onboarding, switching, subscriptions, partners and community, and the platform foundation of identity, mobile shell, audit and integrations.

rootGroups.name: Client Administration App
rootGroups.description: The web and mobile application (mijn.keesdeboekhouder.nl and the iOS and Android app) through which more than 10,000 freelancers keep their administration in almost no time: the real-time dashboard and tax position, deadlines and to-dos, Scan & Herken for receipts, expense bookings and the document archive, quotes and invoices under multiple trading names with payment tracking, and the Ponto bank connection with automatic transaction matching.

bricks.name: Financial Dashboard and Quarterly Results
bricks.description: The home screen of mijn.keesdeboekhouder.nl and the mobile app: direct insight into revenue per quarter, cost categories, investments, profit and the VAT to pay or receive per quarter, updated in real time as receipts, invoices and bank transactions are booked. It turns the ledger that the bookkeeper maintains into the picture a freelancer actually looks at, and it is the first thing a starter sees after onboarding and the reference point for every 'how am I doing' question to the bookkeeper.

bricks.name: VAT Position and Tax Reservation View
bricks.description: Shows a client what they will owe at any moment: the VAT to pay or receive for the running quarter, the estimated income tax on the year-to-date profit after zelfstandigenaftrek, startersaftrek and mkb-winstvrijstelling, and the amount to reserve so that the quarterly VAT payment and the annual income tax bill never come as a surprise. It is the answer to the knowledge freelancer's 'what is my real profit and what should I put aside' and to the most common surprise-bill complaint among creatives.

bricks.name: Scan & Herken Receipt Capture and Recognition
bricks.description: Scan & Herken: photograph a receipt in the mobile app, upload a purchase invoice in the web app or forward it to the client's personal e-mail-in address, and have supplier, date, amount, VAT rate and a suggested cost category recognised automatically. Recognised items become expense bookings ready for the bookkeeper to check. It is the brick that makes 'administration in almost no time' true for creatives with many small receipts, and its recognition accuracy directly drives bookkeeper productivity.

Bookings are posted to the ledger and appear on the dashboard immediately, and each one is what the bookkeeper checks before the quarterly VAT return.
